The season began on 28 March and ended on 15 December 2025.{{cite web|url=https://eldeber.com.bo/futbol/la-division-profesional-tendra-dos-torneos-este-ano-y-comenzara-el-30-de-marzo_506428/ |title=La División Profesional tendrá dos torneos este año y comenzará el 30 de marzo |trans-title=The División Profesional will have two tournaments this year and will begin on 30 March |publisher=[[El Deber]] |language=es |date=12 March 2025 |access-date=12 March 2025}}{{cite web|url=https://www.vision360.bo/noticias/2025/11/27/36043-el-torneo-largo-concluira-hasta-el-14-pero-el-cierre-de-la-temporada-se-alargaria-hasta-despues-de-navidad |title=El torneo largo concluirá hasta el 14, pero el cierre de la temporada se alargaría hasta después de Navidad |trans-title=The round-robin tournament will conclude on the 14th, but the season's closure would be extended until after Christmas |publisher=Visión 360 |language=es |date=27 November 2025 |access-date=27 November 2025}} Although the season was originally expected to begin on 14 February 2025,{{cite web|url=https://www.eldeber.com.bo/futbol/el-campeonato-2025-de-la-division-profesional-ya-tiene-fecha-de-inicio_501906/ |title=El campeonato 2025 de la División Profesional ya tiene fecha de inicio |trans-title=The 2025 División Profesional championship already has a start date |publisher=[[El Deber]] |language=es |date=29 January 2025 |access-date=29 January 2025}} delays in the resolution of disciplinary cases that could affect the club composition for the season eventually forced the start date to be moved to 28 March.{{cite web|url=https://correodelsur.com/deporte/20250209/la-division-profesional-comenzara-en-abril-antes-se-jugara-un-torneo-de-verano.html |title=La División Profesional comenzará en abril; antes se jugará un torneo de verano |trans-title=The División Profesional will begin in April; a summer tournament will be played prior to it |publisher=[[Correo del Sur]] |language=es |date=9 February 2025 |access-date=10 February 2025}} [[Club Always Ready|Always Ready]] were the champions, winning their fourth league title on the penultimate matchday of the season after defeating [[Club Deportivo Guabirá|Guabirá]] 6–0 on 11 December 2025.{{cite web|url=https://premiumsportsbo.com/always-ready-golea-y-es-campeon-del-futbol-boliviano/ |title=Always golea y es campeón del fútbol boliviano |trans-title=Always thrash and become Bolivian football champions |publisher=Premium |language=es |date=11 December 2025 |access-date=11 December 2025}} [[Club Bolívar|Bolívar]] were the defending champions. On 28 February 2025, [[Club Aurora|Aurora]] were deducted 33 points ahead of the season, as punishment for the [[Gabriel Montaño]] case.{{cite web|url=https://www.lostiempos.com/deportes/futbol/20250228/urgente-tdd-emite-dura-sancion-contra-aurora-gabriel-montano-dos-dirigentes|title=Urgente: TDD emite dura sanción contra Aurora, Gabriel Montaño y dos dirigentes celestes|trans-title=Urgent: TDD set harsh punishment against Aurora, Gabriel Montaño and two ''celeste'' board members|publisher=[[Los Tiempos]]|language=es|date=28 February 2025|access-date=2 March 2025}} Due to that point deduction, Aurora had been mathematically relegated to the [[Bolivian Football Regional Leagues#Cochabamba Football Association Championship|Cochabamba regional league]] with five matches left in the season after losing to [[GV San José]] on 21 November.{{cite web|url=https://diez.bo/futbol/2025-11-21-19-47-47-aurora-desciende-de-categoria-despues-de-8-anos-y-solo-un-fallo-del-tas-lo-puede-salvar |title=Aurora desciende de categoría después de 8 años y solo un fallo del TAS lo puede salvar |trans-title=Aurora are relegated after 8 years and only a CAS ruling can save them |publisher=[[El Deber|Diez]] |language=es |date=21 November 2025 |access-date=22 November 2025}} However, the ruling was overturned by the [[Court of Arbitration for Sport]] on 19 December following an appeal lodged by Aurora, which meant that Aurora went up to tenth place with 37 points and [[C.D. Jorge Wilstermann|Jorge Wilstermann]] went from second to last place to last, being relegated directly to the regional leagues.{{cite web|url=https://premiumsportsbo.com/aurora-gana-una-apelacion-en-el-tas-y-no-desciende/ |title=Aurora gana una apelación en el TAS y no desciende |trans-title=Aurora win an appeal at the CAS and avoid relegation |publisher=Premium |language=es |date=19 December 2025 |access-date=19 December 2025}} ==Format== The format for the season was decided at a meeting of the División Profesional's Council on 11 March 2025, following the resolution of disciplinary cases involving the club [[Royal Pari F.C.|Royal Pari]] and [[Club Aurora|Aurora]] player [[Gabriel Montaño]]. The 2025 season would no longer continue the half-year tournaments in a single season. Instead, a double [[Round-robin tournament|round-robin]] league competition in which the 16 participating teams played each other twice for a total of 30 rounds. The season would start on 30 March and end in December. The team finishing first after the 30 rounds of the league tournament at the end of the season was the División Profesional champion. The champions and runners-up of the league tournament qualified for the [[2026 Copa Libertadores]] group stage as ''Bolivia 1'' and ''Bolivia 2'', whilst the Copa Bolivia champions will qualify for the Copa Libertadores as ''Bolivia 3'' and the runners-up of the latter tournament will claim the last berth to the [[2026 Copa Sudamericana]]. The remaining international berths were awarded to the best-placed teams in the league tournament, whilst the team placing last in this tournament was relegated and the team placing second-from-bottom will have to play a relegation play-off against the [[Copa Simón Bolívar (Bolivia)|Copa Simón Bolívar]] runner-up. No aggregate table was considered for this season.{{cite web|url=https://eldeber.com.bo/futbol/asi-sera-la-reparticion-de-premios-de-la-division-profesional-2025_506452/ |title=Así será la repartición de premios de la División Profesional 2025 |trans-title=This will be the prize distribution of the 2025 División Profesional |publisher=[[El Deber]] |language=es |date=12 March 2025 |access-date=12 March 2025}} ==Teams== Sixteen teams competed in the league for the 2025 season: the top 14 teams in the aggregate table of the 2024 Primera División season, along with [[Academia del Balompié Boliviano|ABB]] who promoted from the 2024 [[Copa Simón Bolívar (Bolivia)|Copa Simón Bolívar]] and [[CDT Real Oruro|Real Oruro]], who took part in the [[2024 Bolivian Primera División season#Promotion/relegation play-off|promotion/relegation play-off]]. ABB achieved a first-ever promotion to the top tier on 1 December 2024, after winning the Copa Simón Bolívar title.{{cite
